title: Pause All AGV Movement Through the OptiSweep WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API PauseAgvs operation in Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client to request that Geek pause movement for all AGVs. PauseAgvs is not an AE stop.
when_to_use: Use when support needs to request a pause of movement for all AGVs through the live OptiSweep / WCS API.
not_for: Do not use or describe PauseAgvs as an AE stop.
Do not use this procedure as a physical E-stop procedure.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Submit the PauseAgvs request through the OptiSweep / WCS API and verify the resulting live AGV movement state.

safety_notes: PauseAgvs requests Geek to pause all AGV movement; the source explicitly distinguishes this operation from an AE stop.
Treat the operation as a software request to Geek, not as a physical safety stop.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog or equivalent WCS API client
Live AGV fleet status UI or live movement observation

access_required: L2 support access to the OptiSweep / WCS API and Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client
Access to a live AGV fleet status view or another live movement observation
system_preconditions: The OptiSweep / WCS API is reachable.
The AGV operations are available in the API client.

visual_references.description: OptiSweep API overview showing the AGVs API group and PauseAgvs operation in Apidog.
AGVs API screen identifying POST PauseAgvs and its effect of requesting Geek to pause all AGV movement; it also distinguishes the operation from AE.
AGVs status view showing live AGV state, current command, vitals, AGV errors, and system errors for post-request verification.

steps.title: Open the PauseAgvs operation in the OptiSweep / WCS API client
steps.purpose: Identify the live API operation that requests a pause of movement for all AGVs.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client, open the AGVs API group and locate the operation labeled POST PauseAgvs.
steps.expected_result: The AGVs API group displays the POST PauseAgvs operation and it is available for submission.
steps.healthy_condition: The OptiSweep / WCS API client is reachable and POST PauseAgvs is present under the AGVs operations.
steps.failure_condition: The API client cannot reach the OptiSweep / WCS API or the PauseAgvs operation is unavailable.

actions.label: Locate PauseAgvs
actions.exact_action: Open the AGVs API group and locate POST PauseAgvs.

stop_or_escalate_if: The OptiSweep / WCS API client cannot be reached.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OptiSweep provides APIs to get data and make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers, and the API list includes AGV operations.
The AGVs API list identifies POST PauseAgvs.

steps.title: Submit POST PauseAgvs
steps.purpose: Send the software request to Geek to pause movement for all AGVs.
steps.instruction: Submit the POST PauseAgvs request in the OptiSweep / WCS API client. Do not represent or handle this request as an AE stop.
steps.expected_result: The POST PauseAgvs request is submitted to request that Geek pause all AGV movement.
steps.healthy_condition: The request is accepted for submission by the OptiSweep / WCS API client and the operation is treated as a pause request rather than an AE stop.
steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted, or the operation is being interpreted as an AE stop.
stop_or_escalate_if: The POST PauseAgvs request cannot be submitted.
The operation is being treated as an AE stop or another safety-stop function.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: PauseAgvs makes a request to Geek to pause all AGV movement and is not AE.

steps.title: Verify the live AGV movement state
steps.purpose: Confirm that the pause request produced the intended live fleet behavior.
steps.instruction: Observe the live AGV fleet status in the RMS / fleet status UI or equivalent live AGV status view after submitting PauseAgvs. Check the current AGV state, current command, vitals, and any AGV or system errors, and confirm that AGV movement is paused.
steps.expected_result: The live fleet observation shows that AGV movement is paused; the status view remains available for reviewing current AGV state, command, vitals, and errors.
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs are no longer moving after the PauseAgvs request, with the live fleet status view available for inspection.
steps.failure_condition: AGV movement continues after the request, or the live status view shows an AGV or system error that prevents confirmation of the paused state.

actions.label: Inspect live fleet state
actions.exact_action: Observe the live AGV fleet status and verify that AGV movement is paused.

stop_or_escalate_if: AGV movement continues after the PauseAgvs request.
The live AGV state cannot be observed or the pause cannot be verified.
The status view shows an AGV error or system error associated with the request.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows the current state of AGVs, their current command, vitals, AGV errors, and system errors.
PauseAgvs requests Geek to pause all AGV movement.

success_criteria: POST PauseAgvs is submitted through the OptiSweep / WCS API.
Geek receives a request to pause movement for all AGVs.
Live AGV observation confirms that AGV movement is paused.
The operation is recorded and communicated as a software pause request, not an AE stop.
healthy_conditions: The AGVs API group contains POST PauseAgvs.
The API request is submitted successfully.
Live AGV status or movement observation shows no continuing AGV movement after the request.
The live status view is available to review AGV state, current command, vitals, and AGV or system errors.
failure_conditions: The OptiSweep / WCS API or Apidog client is unavailable.
AGV movement continues after the request.
The live AGV status view cannot confirm the paused state.
The operation is incorrectly treated as an AE stop.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the request cannot be submitted through the OptiSweep / WCS API.
Escalate if AGV movement continues after POST PauseAgvs.
Escalate if live AGV or system errors prevent verification of the paused state.
Use the appropriate physical safety response separately if an AE stop is required; PauseAgvs is not an AE stop.
